purpose: Track provenance, evidence class, permitted use assumptions, and relevance of every data source used to shape SABLE's pre-test readiness evidence gate.

evidence_classes.public_requirements: Publicly hosted specifications/regulations used to define a general requirement vocabulary; not proof of a live project's obligations.
evidence_classes.public_operational_benchmark: Published operational measurements and labels; useful only for the problem domain and schema it covers, not commissioning document-closure ground truth.
evidence_classes.synthetic_mutation: Authored test mutations with expected outputs; proves behavior against declared test cases, not real-world recall/precision.
evidence_classes.customer_authorized: Customer sample shared under written authority, scope and retention terms; not present yet.
evidence_classes.independently_labeled_customer: Customer-authorized sample plus an independent domain reviewer label for every expected exception; not present yet.

sources.title: Building Commissioning — Unified Facilities Guide Specification
sources.publisher: Whole Building Design Guide / USACE / NAVFAC / AFCEC
sources.relevance: Readiness certificate, issues-log lifecycle, test procedure/retest, witness context, commissioning report content and possible aborted/retest cost consequence.
sources.extraction_mode: Authored summaries and section/page pointers; source PDF not copied into this repository.
sources.use_guardrail: The guide requires project tailoring. The live project's executed specification, owner checklist, approved submittals and amendments must establish applicability. Never infer a current payment hold from the general guide.
sources.license_status: Publicly accessible source; downstream derivative redistribution rights have not been separately adjudicated.

sources.title: Japan Edited Specifications (JES) 1.6
sources.publisher: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Japan District public web host
sources.relevance: Publicly hosted edited specification/submittal-register example listing commissioning plans, issue logs, commissioning reports and Certificate of Readiness as named submittal/evidence objects.
sources.extraction_mode: Cataloged from the official-public search-index extract; the PDF host did not return a stable direct-open response during this run.
sources.use_guardrail: A government edited specification is still a reference/template unless linked to the actual contract. Do not treat it as an executed project package or evidence that a project followed the process.
sources.license_status: No source content redistributed. Reuse rights for derivative extracts not separately adjudicated.

sources.title: Engineering Regulation ER 1110-345-723
sources.publisher: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, official publications host
sources.relevance: Engineering Regulation summary states commissioning documentation includes a construction-phase commissioning plan, issues log, Certificate of Readiness, design review report and training plan.
sources.extraction_mode: Short official search-index extract only; direct PDF open returned access denied during this research pass.
sources.use_guardrail: Only use as a secondary requirements cross-check. Verify exact current version and project applicability before production use.
sources.license_status: No source content redistributed; exact reuse/edition applicability not independently adjudicated.

sources.title: LBNL Fault Detection and Diagnostics Data Sets
sources.publisher: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory with DOE and research partners
sources.revision: Dataset DOI 10.25984/1881324; public catalog page current as accessed 2026-10-11
sources.relevance: Publicly labeled HVAC fault/fault-free time-series data spanning seven common system/equipment classes; source notes mix of simulation, laboratory experiments and field measurements.
sources.extraction_mode: Dataset inventory and licensing/provenance metadata only; bulk files have not been downloaded, inspected or incorporated into SABLE.
sources.use_guardrail: This is an adjacent operational fault-detection dataset, not a commissioning readiness certificate/issue log/test witness/turnover dataset. It cannot validate SABLE's document-closure recall/precision. Verify exact dataset license and citation requirements before republishing any data.
sources.license_status: OEDI/Data.gov catalog indicates publicly accessible with a CC license label; precise terms should be confirmed on the source record before redistribution.

sources.title: Authored commissioning evidence graph mutation benchmark
sources.relevance: 16 deterministic cases: one complete synthetic graph plus 15 authored mutations including readiness-certificate gaps, test-before-approval, open-issue/readiness contradiction, source mismatch and missing links.
sources.extraction_mode: Explicit code/data fixtures with expected verdict and finding-code labels.
sources.use_guardrail: Current CI checks every authored mutation. This is not customer data and does not establish real-world sensitivity, precision, economic impact, or external validation.

sources.title: First customer-authorized commissioning/turnover sample
sources.relevance: Critical missing dataset for validation of real-document evidence links and customer value.
sources.extraction_mode: Pending written permission and secure transfer agreement.
sources.use_guardrail: No sample will be accepted until the data owner authorizes the purpose, transfer channel, retention/deletion and permitted output reuse. Do not place customer evidence in this public repo.
sources.license_status: Not applicable until specific permission/contract is obtained.

sources.title: Independently reviewed customer labels
sources.relevance: Needed to measure true gaps, false positives, misses, UNKNOWN rate and decision impact with a domain reviewer.
sources.use_guardrail: Do not train on or reuse labels beyond the explicitly licensed scope. Keep reviewer decisions independent from SABLE-produced predictions.
sources.license_status: Not applicable until specific permission/contract is obtained.

current_truth.warning: Public source records are genuine. The executable graph test fixture is synthetic. The public LBNL dataset is real public operational benchmark data but is not relevant ground truth for readiness-document closure until a justified, separately scoped mapping exists. Do not combine these classes in evaluation claims.
